<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 134.10955, which in ESI positive mode corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈133.102 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈11 % M+1 intensity) indicates about ten carbon atoms. The formula C₁₀H₁₃ matches this exact mass within a few ppm (calculated neutral mass 133.1017 Da). Hence the molecular formula is C₁₀H₁₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
